Let me analyze this task. It's a parking app notification (push notification) in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage).

The situation: User parked at 信義停車場 (Xinyi Parking Lot), the timer has 10 minutes until expiration, overtime costs NT$60 per hour.

s1: notification title
s2: notification body

I need to apply the component framework. A push notification isn't in the table explicitly, but the closest analogues:
- Title: like a dialog title — the name of the decision/action. Actually for push notifications, the title is typically short and identifies the subject: 「停車計時」or「計時將到期」
- Body: only include what the reader needs to decide/act, consequences not already shown. Include the fact: 10 minutes remaining, overtime rate NT$60/hour.

Let me think about what the user needs:
- Where: 信義停車場
- Time: 10 minutes left
- Consequence: 超時每小時 NT$60 (overtime is NT$60/hour)

Push notification standards: title short, body informative, includes action needed. The body should give the decision-relevant info: "信義停車場的計時還有 10 分鐘到期。超時每小時 NT$60。"

Title options:
- 「停車計時將到期」— names the situation/action
- 「計時還有 10 分鐘」— value-like
- 「停車時間即將到期」

For push notifications, the title typically identifies the app context/subject: 停車計時 or 計時將到期. The body then carries details.

Think about the one job per string:
- s1: the name of this event/decision → 「停車計時將到期」or「計時快到期」
- s2: only the facts needed: parking lot name, remaining time, the overtime rate (which changes how the user reads urgency).

Body: 「信義停車場的計時還有 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60。」

Hmm, should I use 「還有 10 分鐘」or「剩餘 10 分鐘」? Taiwan usage: 「還有 10 分鐘」 is natural. 「即將到期」or「將到期」.

Title: 「停車計時將到期」 — clear, names the event.
Body: 「信義停車場還有 10 分鐘到期，超時每小時 NT$60。」

Actually, per the note guidance: "一句會改變旁邊數字或清單怎麼讀的事實" — the overtime rate changes how to read the 10 minutes (it tells urgency/cost). So including it in body is right.

Full-width punctuation: 「。」should end the sentence. Numbers: NT$60. Time: 10 分鐘.

Let me draft:

s1: 停車計時將到期
s2: 信義停車場的計時還有 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60。

Alternatively body: 「信義停車場計時還有 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60。」

Should the title include the parking lot name? Push notification titles are often just the subject. The body carries specifics. Keep title generic: 「停車計時將到期」or simply 「計時將到期」. 「停車計時」clarifies context since it's a parking app.

Actually, maybe the title should be the value: 「還有 10 分鐘」? No — title naming the decision is better: the user needs to decide whether to extend/return. Title: 「停車計時將到期」.

Punctuation check: 「，」「。」full-width. 「NT$60」— the example uses $4,812.00 style. NT$60 is fine.

Range dash not needed here.

Final:

{"s1":"停車計時將到期","s2":"信義停車場的計時還有 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60。"}

Only return JSON.{"s1":"停車計時將到期","s2":"信義停車場的計時還有 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60。"}
